reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (declared 'best, ship' in REPORT): KS yaw-rate psi_dot=(v/L)*tan(delta) with L=2.984 (Mach-E wheelbase per code/parameters.py PARAM_BY_PLATFORM) minus a per-segment bias = mean residual on straight-line samples (|delta|<0.01).
notes: Agent V1 procedure (KS + per-segment straight-line bias removal) is platform-agnostic at evaluation time: the only fixed parameter is L. Agent fit and reported on 12 Mach-E segments only; here we extend the same procedure (with agent's Mach-E L=2.984) across all 545 canonical Ford segments including 230 F-150 Lightning segments (true L=3.70), so Lightning predictions use the wrong wheelbase by agent's own platform choice. Per-segment bias is recomputed per segment from its own straight-line samples (agent's exact recipe).
